description: Airbnb stays for a place and dates (first results page, usually 18): listing id, name, type, total price for the stay in the chosen currency (and original price when discounted), rating out of 5 with review count, beds/bathrooms, badges such as Guest favourite, free-cancellation note, coordinates and room URL. From Airbnb's public search page; availability and prices as Airbnb shows them at call time. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
